FaqsComp.heading: Frequently Asked Questions – MSG91 Hello United Kingdom

faqs.question: What is customer support software, and why do UK businesses need it?
faqs.answer:
• Customer support software helps businesses receive, organise, assign and resolve customer enquiries through one platform.
  • A UK business may receive order questions through email, complaints on social media, WhatsApp messages about deliveries, and requests through its website chat widget.
  • When these conversations are handled separately, important details can be missed and customers may have to repeat their concerns.
  • MSG91 Hello is customer support software for UK businesses that brings these interactions into one shared inbox with ticket management, AI chatbots, automation and reporting.
  • Its unlimited-agent model also makes it easier for growing businesses to add support representatives without paying additional per-agent licence fees.

faqs.question: What is MSG91 Hello, and how does it work?
faqs.answer:
• MSG91 Hello is an AI-powered customer service platform in the UK designed to help businesses manage customer conversations, automate replies and track support requests.
  • Businesses connect their communication channels, invite agents, create departments and configure ticket-routing workflows.
  • The platform's no-code chatbot builder allows teams to create an initial agentic AI bot using a prompt. Rule-based steps can then be added for specific tasks such as collecting reference numbers or directing enquiries to departments.
  • For example, a Manchester-based online retailer can use AI to answer delivery questions while passing refund disputes to the appropriate support agent.
  • Managers can monitor ticket volumes, agent activity and customer satisfaction through the reporting dashboard.

faqs.question: Which customer communication channels can UK businesses manage in MSG91 Hello?
faqs.answer:
• MSG91 Hello supports shared-inbox workflows for WhatsApp, Instagram, Facebook Messenger, email, website live chat, SMS, RCS, X (Twitter), and configured calling services. Apple Messages for Business can also be considered where provisioned.
  • Agents can view customer conversations, ticket status, notes and earlier responses without repeatedly changing applications.
  • For example, a London travel company can respond to WhatsApp itinerary questions, website booking enquiries and emailed cancellation requests from one workspace.
  • The platform also helps teams manage multiple business accounts through its One Inbox capability.

faqs.question: Can MSG91 Hello combine rule-based flows and agentic AI in one chatbot?
faqs.answer:
• Yes. MSG91 Hello combines rule-based chatbot steps and agentic AI within the same conversation.
  • Rule-based steps work well for collecting order references, selecting a service, or asking a customer to choose between predefined options.
  • Agentic AI can interpret more detailed enquiries, answer follow-up questions and use connected applications to retrieve relevant information.
  • For example, a UK broadband provider could ask a customer to choose a service category, then use AI to explain troubleshooting steps or pass a technical fault to an agent.
  • The builder includes no-code configuration, API connections, different AI model options and human handover.

faqs.question: Can multiple agents manage one WhatsApp Business number using MSG91 Hello?
faqs.answer:
• Yes. MSG91 Hello enables several authorised agents to respond through a single connected WhatsApp Business number.
  • Each agent has an individual login, while managers can assign conversations, create departments, review ticket history and add private notes.
  • For example, a UK home furnishings company may direct delivery enquiries to logistics, returns to customer service and payment questions to accounts.
  • This prevents multiple employees from replying without coordination.
  • Hello also includes unlimited agents and teams, removing the need to purchase additional licences simply because the support team has grown.
  • Want to make it easier for customers to contact your business on WhatsApp? Use MSG91's Free WhatsApp Link Generator to create click-to-chat links, QR codes and website chat widgets with optional pre-filled messages. Once your WhatsApp Business channel is connected to MSG91 Hello, your support team can manage customer conversations from the shared inbox.

faqs.question: Can UK support teams manage customer calls through MSG91 Hello?
faqs.answer:
• MSG91 Hello offers cloud calling and IVR functionality within configured customer service workflows.
  • Teams can organise call routing, direct enquiries to departments and retain relevant call information alongside customer tickets.
  • For example, a UK property management company can route repair requests to maintenance, tenancy questions to property managers and payment enquiries to accounts.
  • Agents can also initiate outbound support calls through the Hello mobile app.
  • Calling coverage and telephony features depend on the configured service. AI voice assistance can be used in suitable customer experiences, with separate configuration for website voice and telephone calling.

faqs.question: What is MSG91 Chat Window, and how can it reduce WhatsApp support costs?
faqs.answer:
• MSG91 Chat Window allows a customer to begin a support conversation on WhatsApp and continue it through a separate chat environment connected to MSG91 Hello.
  • This helps UK businesses handle lengthy exchanges involving deliveries, product troubleshooting or account assistance without keeping every message on WhatsApp.
  • For example, a retailer can receive an initial WhatsApp request about a return and continue the detailed exchange in Chat Window.
  • Messages sent inside MSG91 Chat Window do not carry Meta WhatsApp per-message charges. WhatsApp messages themselves remain subject to Meta's applicable pricing.
  • Explore MSG91 Chat Window

faqs.question: How is MSG91 Hello different from Zendesk, Freshdesk, Zoho Desk, and Intercom?
faqs.answer:
• MSG91 Hello combines omnichannel communication, ticket automation, AI chatbots, and configurable calling features in a single platform.
  • One important difference is pricing: MSG91 Hello includes unlimited agents without individual per-agent licence fees.
  • The platform also combines rule-based steps and agentic AI in one chatbot, provides API integrations, and offers Chat Window for WhatsApp-originated support conversations.
  • For UK businesses comparing omnichannel customer support software, these capabilities can reduce manual switching and simplify team expansion.
  • Competing helpdesk solutions offer their own advanced features, integrations and AI products, with pricing and access depending on the chosen plan.

faqs.question: How much does MSG91 Hello cost in the UK? Is there a free plan?
faqs.answer:
• Yes. MSG91 Hello offers four monthly subscription options for UK businesses.
    • Live Chat – £0/month: One inbox with unlimited live-chat tickets.
    • Free – £0/month: Two inboxes and 50 tickets monthly.
    • Basic – £35/month: Two inboxes, 1,000 tickets, and a £35 bot wallet.
    • Premium – £65/month: Three inboxes, 2,000 tickets, and a £65 bot wallet.
  • All plans include unlimited agents and teams, making costs easier to manage as the support team grows.
  • Annual subscription options are also available.
  • Explore MSG91 Hello UK Pricing

faqs.question: Are there extra charges for agents, tickets, inboxes or AI bots?
faqs.answer:
• MSG91 Hello does not charge UK businesses extra per agent.
  • Additional usage on paid monthly plans includes:
    • Extra inboxes: £9 per inbox.
    • Extra tickets: £0.012 per ticket on Basic and £0.025 on Premium.
    • AI chatbot usage: Deducted from the plan's bot wallet according to the rate card.
  • When bot-wallet funds are exhausted, businesses can top up for additional usage.
  • The Free plan does not allow extra ticket or inbox purchases; an upgrade is required. Charges for communication channels and calling may apply separately.
  • View Complete Pricing

faqs.question: Is MSG91 Hello secure, and where is customer data stored for UK businesses?
faqs.answer:
• Yes. MSG91 Hello includes security measures such as encryption, role-based access controls, and permissions for managing customer information. MSG91 has undergone a SOC 2 Type II audit and holds ISO 27001 certification, helping UK businesses assess its approach to data security.
  • MSG91 stores customer data for UK businesses in European data centers, ensuring compliance with GDPR and UK data protection requirements.
  • View MSG91 Security Certificates

faqs.question: Does MSG91 Hello provide free customer support software for UK startups?
faqs.answer:
• Yes. MSG91's Hello Free for Startups programme helps eligible early-stage UK businesses manage customer enquiries without paying a software subscription fee.
  • Registered startups with annual revenue below US$50,000 or the applicable local equivalent can apply for complimentary access. The programme includes up to 1,000 tickets per month, 50 agents, 2 communication inboxes and AI chatbot usage under a fair-use policy.
  • A new UK online retailer, for example, can use Hello to manage order enquiries, automate routine support questions and organise tickets without immediately investing in multiple helpdesk licences.
  • Applications are subject to document verification and programme limits. External messaging and calling charges may apply.
  • Apply for Hello Free for Startups in the UK

faqs.question: How much can UK businesses save by using MSG91 Hello instead of other customer support software?
faqs.answer:
• MSG91 Hello can help UK businesses achieve around 95% lower estimated customer support software costs in selected scenarios, particularly when comparing agent-based subscriptions and AI-related charges.
  • For example, with 3,000 monthly tickets, 12 support agents and 50% AI resolution:
    • MSG91 Hello: £59/month
    • Freshdesk: £915/month
    • Estimated savings: £856/month — 94% lower costs
  • UK businesses can compare Hello against Zendesk, Freshdesk, Intercom, Zoho Desk and other platforms using GBP.
  • The calculator provides a breakdown of subscription charges, agent licences, AI costs and ticket usage. Actual savings vary with the chosen plans and assumptions.
  • Compare Customer Support Software Costs in GBP
